case_number: 2025 INSC 426; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) No.7845 of 2024)

parties.petitioner: The General Manager, Business Network Planning (Retail), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited & Anr.

summary: Retail outlet dealership allocation;误classification as Group 2 despite eligibility for Group 1; clarificatory requests ignored by BPCL; Writ Court directed consideration under Group 1 based on possession of land; standard of deference to public interest and social equity in Scheduled Caste category appointments; contractor selection not immune from judicial review when public duty involved; fairness and transparency required; appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Subodh Kumar Singh Rathour v. The Chief Executive Engineer & Ors.
Selection Guidelines for Retail Outlet Dealership
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment upholding writ petition affirmed; BPCL directed to consider respondent as Group 1 applicant and pass fresh orders in accordance with law.
